summary: All four F2 D0-15 contract-stop claims reproduce. The accepted F1 pack also has additional blocker-level contradictions against ratified D0: stale bootstrap states, no request stale state, no durable page-snapshot payload or complete graph binding, the wrong standalone error envelope, and absent restore/bootstrap recovery vectors. The current F2 worktree separately contains implementation defects. It must not be accepted, and the accepted F1 contract bytes must be corrected and independently requalified before F2 restarts.

I did not author, repair, normalize, format, stage, commit, push, execute, or otherwise contribute to D0, F1, F2, product, workflow, expected outcomes, or runtime bytes.
